text: ASML’s Scope 1 footprint has historically been defined as emissions from the combustion of natural gas and purchased CO₂.
ASML's Scope 1 footprint has historically been defined as emissions from purchased CO₂.

The evidence states that ASML calculated its direct Scope 1 CO₂ footprint from manufacturing-site electricity consumption using local conversion factors, which is incompatible with defining it as emissions from purchased CO₂.
